result.instructions: Tools for Auvo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which technicians have tasks tomorrow, and how many does each one have?"; "Show me the open tasks for customer 42 from this month."; "Create a high-priority task for technician 7 at customer 42 for next Monday at 09:00.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Auvo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run auvo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run auvo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run auvo_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. auvo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: auvo_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the admin, manager and technician users of the Auvo account (paged). Auvo API: GET /users.

filter.description: Filter object sent as Auvo paramFilter. Known keys: userId, name, smartPhoneNumber, userType (1 user, 2 manager, 3 administrator), externalId.

tools.name: auvo_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Return one Auvo user by id. Auvo API: GET /users/{id}.

id.description: Record id from a list call.

tools.name: auvo_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers of the Auvo account (paged). Auvo API: GET /customers.

filter.description: Filter object sent as Auvo paramFilter. Known keys: id, description (name), externalId, segmentId, groupId, active, dateLastUpdate, creationDate, legalName, cpfCnpj.

tools.name: auvo_get_customer

id.description: Record id from a list call.

tools.name: auvo_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List field-service tasks (work orders). Filter by date range, technician, customer, team or status. Auvo API: GET /tasks.

filter.description: Filter object sent as Auvo paramFilter. Known keys: taskID, externalId, idUserTo, startDate and endDate (yyyy-MM-dd), type, typeList, customerId, customerGroupId, teamId, status (0 not finished, 1 auto finished, 2 manual finished, 3 auto or manual, 4 all, 5 with pendency, 6 started or finished, 7 in execution), orientation, tags, priority (1 low, 2 medium, 3 high), dateLastUpdate, questionnairesId.

tools.name: auvo_create_customer

tools.name: auvo_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: Create a field-service task for a technician. Creates a new task and notifies the assignee. Auvo API: POST /tasks.

idUserTo.description: User id of the technician who executes the task.

externalId.description: Your own id for this task.
